controls.title: Change management: the entity authorizes, designs, develops or acquires, configures, documents, tests, approves and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software and procedures

assertions.statement: Every change that was applied was cleared by the gate, under a recorded tier, before it was applied.
Every human-cleared change was approved by distinct subjects the approval route checked were people, none automation.
What a deployment applied is the digest that was cleared (manifest tree or saved plan).
Every failed change was rolled back.
No change landed outside a clearance, in a window whose observation feeds were verified.
The records this packet rests on are under a witnessed ledger checkpoint.
